title: CI source-gates never runs 36 top-level test files or test/e2e/release -- a green PR says nothing about them
description: Found 2026-09-25 while wiring QCLI-292. The required source-gates context runs scripts/qualification/prepublish.mjs, whose runSourceGates runs bun test on SEVEN paths only: test/domain, test/contract, test/integration, test/cli-tracker-process.test.ts, test/fault/git/local-git.test.ts, test/e2e/migration, test/scale. No workflow runs the full suite. Grep of .github/workflows for bun test finds only projection-platform.yml running one sqlite file. So `ls test/*.test.ts` (36 files at d739f60, including every qcliNNN regression test: qcli300 CI wrapper gate, qcli304, qcli314 promotion fast-forward, qcli346, qcli371 plugin tests, etc.) and all of test/e2e/release/ (publish-release, registry-visibility, e2e-receipt) run ONLY when someone runs bun run check locally. A PR that breaks any of them goes green in CI. OBJECT MEASURED: prepublish.mjs runSourceGates at this branch, and .github/workflows/*.yml. NOT MEASURED: whether any of those files currently fails (local bun run check passes with 660 tests, so none do today). QCLI-292 gated its own check by adding a dedicated lockfile_pins gate rather than relying on its test file, for exactly this reason.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every test file under test/ is run by a required CI context, or is listed with a written reason for being excluded
A test deliberately broken in a top-level test/*.test.ts file turns the required context red, and the same PR with the break reverted turns it green (two measurements)
The prepublication qualification record still names each gate, so a failure says which suite broke
